name: AP / AUTOPILOT
description: Both autopilot systems are lost. AP on Warning Unit for 10 sec, AUTOPILOT on Master List, audio tone and voice message "HANDS ON".

procedure.heading: If unsuccessful:
procedure.text:
3. Airspeed — Reduce to VNE AP OFF (110 kt)
4. LAND AS SOON AS PRACTICABLE
Observe the operating limitations for flight with BACKUP SAS or AFCS OFF (Sect. 2.6.4), if possible.
